subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing - GPU type & throughput follow-up
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@fintechai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity - follow up + numbers

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning - really helpful to see Redwood's runtime and the routing options. As promised, here's a quick summary of our expected workload so you can recommend the right dedicated capacity config and a rough price range: 

- Typical monthly usage: ~600M tokens (mix of chat + long-form generation)
- Peak 99th percentile QPS: ~10 requests/sec with average response length ~300 tokens
- Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for single-shot chat flows
- Preferred GPU options: we don't have a hard requirement, but want guidance between A100-80GB vs H100 and how that impacts $/1M tokens
- Budget: aiming for a committed spend in the $40k-$75k/month range (open to 12/36-mo terms if unit economics improve)

Can you send a short recap with recommended GPU type, reserved capacity size (number of GPUs), estimated throughput (tokens/sec or RPS) and a target $/1M tokens range so I can align with Procurement?

Also attaching our internal forecast (attached in the drive) - happy to jump on another call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of AI Platform
FinTech AI

Attachments referenced: fintechai-forecast-q3.csv (referenced in Drive)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity - follow up + numbers

Hi Alyssa - great talking earlier, appreciate the clear numbers. Quick recap + baseline recommendations below. I attached a one-page proposal + SLA summary for Procurement (proposal-dedicated-capacity-v1.pdf, redwood-sla-summary.pdf).

Recap of your ask (confirming): 600M tokens/month; target p95 latency <400ms; peak ~10 RPS with ~300 tokens/response. Budget target $40k-$75k/month; prefer committed term if that improves unit economics.

Recommended configs (starter options):

1) H100 (best latency/throughput)
   - Reserved pool: 4x H100 80GB (shared across routing)
   - Expected steady throughput: ~1.6M tokens/min (~26.6k tokens/sec across pool) under our optimized serving runtime with batching & KV caching for chat flows
   - Expected p95 latency with 300-token responses: ~250-350ms (depends on batching policy)
   - Estimated unit cost: $420-$650 per 1M tokens (range depends on commit length and reserved utilization)

2) A100 80GB (cost-efficient, slightly lower perf)
   - Reserved pool: 6x A100 80GB
   - Expected steady throughput: ~1.0M tokens/min (~16.6k tokens/sec across pool)
   - Expected p95 latency with 300-token responses: ~350-500ms
   - Estimated unit cost: $300-$520 per 1M tokens

Sizing notes:
- We estimated pool sizes to meet your peak ~10 RPS with headroom for burst and background work (embeddings/re-ranking). If you need strict headroom for heavy peaks, bump H100 pool to 6 GPUs.
- Committed term discounts: 12-month commit ~10-18% off list per-token; 36-month commit ~18-30% off depending on utilization SLAs.
- We recommend starting with H100 x4 for the best latency footprint (fits your p95 target) and then adjust after a 30-day capacity test.

Next steps I suggest:
- I'll loop in Marcus on final pricing/discount approvals (cc'd).
- I'll share a short mutual action plan + formal one-page quote by EOD.
- Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review the formal quote and procurement asks?

Let me know if any of the throughput assumptions (tokens per response, percent chat vs. long-form) need adjusting.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks both - quick pricing context from my side.

On Jun 5, 2026, at 11:05 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> We recommend starting with H100 x4 ... Estimated unit cost: $420-$650 per 1M tokens

A few clarifying notes:
- For a 12-month committed contract at expected utilization (~70-80% sustained), expect to land toward the lower end of Marissa's H100 range (around $420-$480 / 1M tokens) once we apply standard commit discounts and utilization credits.
- For higher commit (36-mo) or if FinTech AI can guarantee higher utilization windows, we can push toward $350-$420 / 1M tokens.
- A100 pools are cheaper but will probably require the larger pool size Marissa suggested and will have looser latency SLOs.

Procurement ask: if you can confirm committed term (12 vs 36) and an initial utilization target (we typically model 70% as base), I'll put together formal pricing tables and carve-outs for burst capacity.

I'll also flag Vanessa to provide an ops contact to onboard during the 30-day capacity test.

— Marcus
